proposal.name: Use configured Go evidence in planning and builds

plan.name: Use configured Go evidence in planning and builds
plan.summary: Complete step 5 of parent #564 in one plumbing change: enable the existing Go adapter by default for captured native Go acceptance and route public planning through the independent base lifecycle, while preserving explicit trusted Go adapter overrides, command-only repository checks and unconfigured legacy Go execution, hashes and locks. A draft qualifies only when every full identity has exactly one matching completed eligible test or proposed-production-API compiler failure; a passing, skipped, absent, unfinished, duplicate or mismatched selection blocks it, ordinary build and suite failures merely allow independent base selections to continue, and install, startup, transport, cleanup, deadline and cancellation failures veto qualification while retaining every selector's status and reason in clipped feedback. Candidate execution requires every applicable captured command and exactly one runtime pass per selector, validates execution identities and the actual staged acceptance and declared dependency-input bytes against retained authority before preparation, and admits only planned production changes and allowed new Go regressions through builder staging; candidate repository configuration, replaced locks, diagnostic output, compilation success and the Accepted map cannot replace authority or completion, and pytest, Vitest, Jest, mixed unsupported plans and configured legacy acceptance are refused before preparation without migration. The builder tool, standalone and shared queues, fresh final checks, planner tool and final proposal validation use identical registered rules with identity-and-location-only IPC, fresh executions, one original run deadline and shared test allowance, and queue ownership through bounded uncanceled cleanup; failed final checks block review approval and readiness, with the existing review and repair protocol unchanged. Update SPEC.md, the README, docs/factory.md and planning/build prompts to describe working configured Go admission, the remaining unsupported frameworks and external intake, and the offline pinned-image opt-in in TestConfiguredGoOfflinePinnedImage610; revise the named older refusal and legacy-shaped fixture tests for these intentional behavior changes while preserving their other checks, cite the issue's recorded grounds plus applicable existing Go evidence refinements in SPEC, and leave recording the new Go-admission refinement of D-0316 and D-0321 to the merger because plumbing cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoPublicPlanningAndCandidate610
tests.says: Public planning admits real Go failures on the independent committed base, a production-only correction passes every candidate command and selector, and a pass-plus-fail pair blocks the draft with full identities visible after diagnostic clipping.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoPublicCompilerAttribution610
tests.says: Public planning admits an attributable proposed API compile failure only for its exact selection, independently attempts neighbors, and requires a fresh runtime pass after the API is implemented.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoPublicRefusalsAndVetoes610
tests.says: Supported Go works, but skipped, absent, unfinished, mismatched and duplicate execution, setup/transport/cleanup failures, deadlines and cancellation never qualify a draft; suite failures and Accepted booleans supply no evidence, unsupported or mixed plans and configured legacy records are refused before preparation, and legacy hashes and locks remain valid.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoDirectAuthorityAndStaging610
tests.says: Default direct Go execution uses captured policy, refuses altered execution identities, acceptance sources and declared input bytes before preparation, requires unique runtime passes, and staged builds retain only authorized production, pinned acceptance and permitted Go regressions.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoBuilderToolAndFreshFinal610
tests.says: Standalone and shared-queue builders execute the same registered Go sources and policy for tool and final checks, disregard replacement IPC authority and unplanned files, and block review and readiness when later production edits, forged output or final command failures invalidate an earlier tool pass.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoPlanningQueueOwnsCleanupAndDeadline610
tests.says: Queued public planning holds its slot through bounded cleanup, cancels queued requests without execution, preserves completed evidence, and consumes a single shared phase and original whole-run deadline.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoPlannerToolAndProposalAgree610
tests.says: The configured planner tool and fresh final validation execute real Go against retained independent base authority, propose only failing acceptance, retain source and hash, and detect changed drafts after a successful tool check.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGoOfflinePinnedImage610
tests.says: The mandatory daemon-free public Go control works; with INVARIANT_CONFIGURED_GO_REAL=1 and INVARIANT_GO_ACCEPTANCE_PLATFORM set, an already-local pinned Go image runs base failure to production-only candidate pass offline, refuses skipped and unfinished execution, cleans up each outcome, and fails rather than skips when Docker or the pinned image is unavailable.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and eight acceptance tests covering the complete configured Go planning and build step. The factory check passed: all eight tests fail on the unchanged base, and `repo/` remains untouched.
